what: the recipe and the evidence of the category model that config/category_step.json pins as the step's default (owner, 2026-11-15): a recipe and the data it is measured on; the weights are a git-ignored folder named in config/category_step.json. The held-out bar of D24 (80%) is not met: 54.1% (docs/category_training.md)
status: fitted and pinned as the default of --step category (config/category_step.json, T-203); the held-out bar of D24 is NOT met

recipe.reading: entailment: premise '<company>: <text[:2000]>', hypothesis 'The news about <company> is about <definition>.', one per label (docs/category_step.md)
recipe.pairs: per row, the gold tag a positive and 4 negatives drawn from the other labels
recipe.output: the top label of the row (one tag per row); the extra-label rule of the multi-label experiments is not used
recipe.cv_seed_per_fold: cv_seed + the number of the fold
recipe.reading_sha256_of: definitions, groups, hypothesis template and premise length of src/news_category_stage.py (json, sorted keys); a definition edited later breaks the test
recipe.refit_note: the weights the step runs were refit with seed 0 by scripts/category_heldout_2026_11_15.py (the same seed as the first fold of the cross-validation) and scored once on the held-out before the owner's decision; master's refit command (seed 100, scripts/category_single_cv_2026_11_15.py refit) was not used for them. The pin records the seed of the weights that exist, not of the weights that were planned

evidence.method: 5-fold cross-validation grouped by article, out of fold, top label of each row

untouched_on_the_same_rows_and_tags.why_1214: the two sheet rows that carried only `uncertain` (review order 37 and 568) were not in the earlier cross-validation of the untouched model

evidence.bar: 80% agreement on the held-out single rows (D24): NOT met: 54.1% label agreement on the 135 held-out single rows, scored once with the refit (docs/category_results_2026_11_15/heldout_selected.md); 71.3% on 300 real sub-news (the assistant's tags)
